title: Alert when an alarm SNS topic has no confirmed email subscription
description:
As the owner, I want a check that fires when an alarm SNS topic has no confirmed email subscription, so that alarms never silently reach nobody.

On 2026-10-19 the two alarm topics' email subscriptions had expired unconfirmed and were re-created and confirmed; nothing alerts when a topic loses its confirmed subscription. 26 CloudWatch alarms depend on these topics.

Feature: Alarm delivery health
  Scenario: A topic loses its confirmed subscription
    Given an alarm SNS topic has no confirmed email subscription
    When the delivery check runs
    Then the owner is notified through a channel that does not depend on that topic
